scope: Saved JSON/metadata only; no TIFF/RAW stat, payload hash, decode, feature extraction, matching, fit or subject import. AREA8true is the fixed paired comparator, not physical truth. Private restored feature equality is an actual hash witness; its second whole value was not saved. Coarse image/descriptor/key hashes and factory restoration are producer witnesses. Exact and radius-one site groups describe repeated coordinates; connected groups may chain beyond one pixel and do not establish independence. Returned fit residuals can favor biased maps and are only consistency checks. Graph components/cycle rank/bridges are descriptive, not physical geometry, support, overlap, per-frame placement or quality admission.
